column1: # Phase 16 EDGE — every bullet of the phase doc's "Edge cases", mapped to where it is run (r3 V6): a sub-step of
# edge.sh (its id), another row, a phone row, or a JVM test. A bullet with no entry fails the EDGE row; edge.sh reads
# this file and asserts that every `edge.sh:<id>` named here ran. Bullets are numbered in the doc's order (B01 is the
# first bullet under "## Edge cases"); a bullet with several clauses has one line per clause.

column2: provider package disabled: the app says the provider is off, creates nothing; the tile's face is the day only
provider disabled: Tess's "add" answers "I don't have a calendar to add that to." and writes nowhere
Tessera deleted by another app while the app is open: its events vanish through the observer
the next start or write recreates Tessera whatever else remains (QA calendar present)
synced markers whose local event went with it are dropped from calendar_sync.json
an allowed calendar removed from the phone refuses the Sync ("That calendar is no longer on this phone")
an account calendar removed while one of its events is open read-only: the page closes with a notice, the view refreshes
the allow-list cleared after a sync: the marker stays; the next Sync opens "Can sync to"; delete offers "here" only
a copy whose calendar_id no longer matches the mapping's target: Sync / delete-"both" refuse, `failed mapping stale`
a Sync tapped twice quickly: one copy; the second writes nothing (`ok`)
a local event edited while its Sync runs: the next Sync pushes the edit
calendar_sync.json lost: markers vanish, the next Sync makes a new copy, the old one shows beside the original (recorded)
a synced event whose copy's calendar became read-only: "That calendar is read-only now", `failed calendar read-only`
a synced event whose copy was edited on the other side to another time: the shell still shows only the original
the original deleted by another app: the mapping is dropped at the next read and the copy shows as the account's event
the ≡ pane hiding Tessera: the original leaves the app's views, its copy stays hidden; tile, pod and Tess still show it
the update installed while a slot's hand-picked app has been uninstalled: the slot is taken, the line names the component
column4: the seed's rule takes the component from the layout, whether or not it still resolves (decide(...) with a stale current)

column2: the shell's Calendar pointed back and the shell then updated again: `already run`, the pick kept
column4: the point-back leg (a restart is the same code path as an update: ShellApp.startLauncher)

column2: pm clear after the update: a fresh install, `-> assigned`, nothing replaced
column4: the wiped leg's layout; the seed line itself is in the T2SMOKE-run1 evidence and the upgrade leg's CALENDAR line

column2: the Birthdays calendar deleted by another app: recreated under Tessera Birthdays at the next start or contacts change; Tessera untouched
the provider refuses the create: `birthdays calendar could not be created`, the views show no Birthdays calendar
rows changing under the observer (a content insert loop of 50 events over 10 s): the views refresh without a crash
an event whose dtend < dtstart is refused by the editor
a 10-year daily series with no COUNT: Agenda and Week render with `view … in <ms> ms` ≤ 3000
an RRULE with BYDAY=2TU shows on the right days
an exception that moves an occurrence to another day shows on the new day only
a reminder on an event already past: never notifies, no scheduled alert row
a reminder 0 minutes before
two reminders on one event: two notifications
the phone off across a reminder's time: delivered late, the notification gives the event's time
the reminder broadcast sent twice for one alert, or forged: one notification
a calendar with a null colour: the accent is drawn
two calendars with one colour: both listed by name
a calendar whose display name is empty: its account name is shown
time_12_24 = 24: every time reads "H:mm"
a locale change re-labels months and the first day of the week without a restart
the clock jumped backwards a year: the views follow, no event is lost
column4: the one backwards jump: ring_save, force-stop, ensure_start before its MARK (r3 V4)

column2: the Calendar tile's tap lands on today
ACTION_INSERT with title / beginTime / endTime opens the editor prefilled, saves nothing until Save; calendar_id ignored
a content://com.android.calendar/events/<id> VIEW opens that event
an EDIT on an event outside Tessera opens it read-only
a malformed URI opens today with no crash
the Agenda pod's header tap opens the shell's Calendar on today
People with 5,000 contacts: the list's top rows within 3 s, the jump grid lands on its letter
a contact with 20 numbers: all listed on the card with their labels
a 20 MB contact photo: thumbnail in the list, the full photo on the card, decoded at bounds
a contact deleted while its card is open: the card closes with a notice
a contact linked across two accounts and then one account removed: the remaining raw contact stays a contact
editing a field on an aggregated contact writes to ITS raw contact, never splits; only when that raw contact is editable
Can edit: an account removed from the phone leaves the list and people_edit.json; re-added, it starts unticked
people_edit.json lost: nothing is allowed again, phone-only contacts still editable
a starred change on a contact with one read-only raw contact: refused
column4: the builder's test class name is confirmed at merge

column2: a contact found by the work-profile search: always read-only
non-Latin names and their buckets (张伟, Zoë, "Ærøskøbing")
a name with only a family name; a company-only contact (organisation shown as the name)
a number stored with spaces and dashes matches a search typed without them
WRITE_CONTACTS granted while READ is revoked: reads MISSING, People says it cannot read and offers the grant
READ revoked mid-edit: the edit is lost, nothing half-written; People reopens on its cannot-read notice
SIM removed while importing
a SIM contact with no number; a SIM contact that already exists (either outcome recorded)
column4: recorded clauses when the emulated SIM refuses inserts

column2: a group with no members: "Text the group" shows a notice, no compose
a member with no mobile number is left out of the smsto: list; none left → the notice
a group under an account not on "Can edit": no rename or delete action, the page says why
a group deleted by another app while its page is open: the page closes with a notice
Share when no app receives text/x-vcard: Android's resolver empty state
column4: recorded: the AVD has receivers (the fixture apps)

column2: share of a contact with a photo: the vCard carries PHOTO;ENCODING=b
the People tile: a photo removed while its bubble is on screen (the next event uses another photo)
every photo removed mid-cycle: the static pattern after the current event
a photo that fails to decode: skipped, `[people] tile: photo <lookup> skipped: <why>`
column4: not storable on a device (r3 V6)
